title: Add installer resume and repair

context.summary: Make installer interruption recovery executable through resume and repair commands.
context.background: The installer journal must support recovery after interrupted file generation, compose startup, migrations and healthchecks.

in: Implement resume and repair commands over the transaction journal.
Recover interrupted file generation, dependency checks, Compose startup, migrations and healthchecks.
Add partial rollback recovery and clear diagnostics.
Add interruption tests for each major install phase.
Remove TASK-110-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.
out: Recovering arbitrary manual edits outside MINDORY_HOME.

acceptance_criteria: Interrupted installer runs can be resumed when journal state is recoverable.
Repair can identify and fix known partial installation states.
Rollback can continue after an interrupted rollback.
Diagnostics explain manual actions when automation cannot safely proceed.

manual_checks: Confirm resume and repair operate only inside MINDORY_HOME.

risks: Repair must not guess destructively when the journal is ambiguous.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
